description: Up to 144 consecutive Bitcoin blocks descending from fromHeight (or tip). Returns height, hash, time, size, weight, tx count, fees, subsidy, reward, median fee sat/vB, and pool name for each block. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_chain_tips when you need Recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks; crypto_btc_mempool_pressure when you need Bitcoin mempool pressure state and projected next blocks. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

count.description: Number of consecutive blocks to return, 1 to 144 (default 15)

fromHeight.description: Starting block height (descending downwards, optional default: latest tip)

name: crypto_btc_blocks_range
